items.example: The cat sleeps on the mat.
My dog likes to run.
A bird sings in the tree.
The fish swims in the pond.
The rabbit has long ears.
The duck swims with her babies.
items.exampleZh: 鸭妈妈和小鸭子一起游泳。

items.example: The bear walks in the forest.

The elephant uses its trunk to drink.
The monkey climbs a tree.
The horse runs across the field.
The sheep has soft wool.
The cow eats grass.
The pig rolls in the mud.
A butterfly lands on a flower.
The bee lands on a flower.
The dog wags its tail.
A bird has a wing on each side.

items.example: We see animals at the zoo.
